title: Balanced Brackets
description: Write a function named balanced_brackets that takes a string composed of bracket characters '()[]{}' and returns True if every opening bracket is matched and closed in the correct order, or False otherwise. An empty string is considered balanced.

hidden_tests.kind: an unclosed opening bracket at end
a solitary closing bracket with empty stack

hints: Bracket validation is a classic Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) stack problem.
Inspect the stack state when encountering closing brackets: check if stack is empty, and verify stack.pop() matches the expected pair.
After scanning the entire string, the stack must be completely empty (len(stack) == 0) for the string to be valid.
